fixtures.name: F1_single_block_one_pu1_one_nih
fixtures.contract: single chain block, no exclusions, one hg38 PU.1 interval, one NIH peak

fixtures.name: F2_band_crosses_block_boundary
fixtures.contract: candidate band crossing chain-block boundary: only exact-roundtrip starts survive

withdrawn_assertion.text: supplement must be non-empty because the band crosses a block boundary
withdrawn_assertion.why_it_was_wrong: The boundary in this fixture is a gap (dt=400, dq=400). A window spanning a gap changes length under liftOver, so it can never satisfy the exact-5000 and exact-round-trip gates. There is therefore nothing for the supplement to recover here, and demanding a non-empty supplement demanded something the fixture cannot produce. The contract requirement for F2 -- that only exact round-trip starts survive -- was met.

fixtures.assertion: only exact-round-trip starts survive: the admissible set is a strict, non-empty subset of the band

fixtures.name: F3_ambiguous_multiple_mapping
fixtures.contract: ambiguous/multiple forward mapping: all affected starts excluded
fixtures.assertion: no start whose window touches the duplicated region survives

fixtures.name: F4_reverse_offset_mismatch
fixtures.assertion: the mismatched-offset region must contribute nothing; A_exact must be a strict subset of the band

fixtures.name: F5_exclusion_splits_interval
fixtures.contract: promoter-specific distal exclusion splits one admissible interval into two
fixtures.assertion: the exclusion must split the admissible set into 2 runs

fixtures.name: F6_empty_drawn_side_opposite_nonempty
fixtures.contract: empty drawn side while opposite side is non-empty: draw fails and does not retry
fixtures.assertion: drawn side empty, opposite side non-empty, and an opposite-side retry is refused by the guard

fixtures.name: F7_control_a_b_coincidence_retained
fixtures.contract: CONTROL_A and CONTROL_B independent sub-seeds can coincide and coincidence is retained
fixtures.assertion: independent sub-seeds coincide at the rate a small admissible set implies, and coincidences are retained rather than resampled

fixtures.name: F8_anchor_frequency_counts_promoter_keys
fixtures.contract: anchor_frequency counts distinct overlapping promoter_keys rather than edges or exact starts
fixtures.assertion: anchor_frequency counts distinct promoter_keys (2), not edges (3) and not exact starts (3)

fixtures.name: F9_minus_strand_supplement_recovery
fixtures.contract: EXTRA: minus-strand chain material is invisible to the affine shortcut and must be recovered by the supplement
fixtures.assertion: the affine shortcut certifies nothing here (the only chain is minus-strand), so every admissible start must come from the supplement, and it must be non-empty
